descFull: Direct P2P clipboard and file transfer between your devices: copy on one, paste on another, with no cloud drive or shared account. On a LAN they connect with no server, at full network speed; across networks, NAT hole punching connects them directly. End-to-end encrypted, relay only as a fallback. Mac, Windows, Linux; Android on LAN.
